tagline: A deeper wardrobe of everyday scent.
eyebrow: Morris fragrance by PT Aroma Prima Livindo

story.title: One fragrance label, many moods.
story.body: Morris by PT Aroma Prima Livindo spans everyday Eau de Parfum, gourmand, fantasy, travel and other fragrance families. The official catalogue shows a broad portfolio designed around approachable scent stories, while manufacturing is based in Tangerang.

highlights.title: Fantasy Edition
highlights.body: Playful scent identities such as Beauty Inside, Surprise Me, Feel Free and Cozy Life create an easy discovery entry point.

highlights.title: Gourmand direction
highlights.body: Pistachio, vanilla and smoothie-inspired releases show a contemporary gourmand side of the Morris portfolio.

highlights.title: Broad fragrance wardrobe
highlights.body: The official catalogue spans women, men, travel, themed and everyday fragrance formats.

highlights.title: Local manufacturing
highlights.body: Aroma Prima Livindo lists its factory in the Balaraja industrial area of Tangerang, Indonesia.

gallery.label: Fantasy Edition
gallery.caption: Six playful scent stories in one recognizable Morris family.

gallery.label: Morris Tropical Edition
gallery.caption: Varian aroma buah tropis segar tahan lama untuk aktivitas harian.

gallery.label: Morris Robot Futuristic Edition
gallery.caption: Parfum pria maskulin berkarakter modern energik kemasan botol robot ikonik.
